question: Acidified KMnO₄ can be used:

options.text: to get alcohol directly from carboxylic acids
to get carboxylic acids directly from alcohol
to get formic acid from formaldehyde

solution:
The correct answer is __**Option 2.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Acidified KMnO4 can be used to get **carboxylic acids directly from alcohol. Hence, option 2 is correct.**
 
• KMnO4 solution decolourises when it reduced to Mn2+ (in acidic medium).
 
• So basically by oxidation-reduction process KMnO4 solution decolorises.
 
• Now in KMnO4 solution oxidation state of Mn is +7 and it reduced to Mn2+ then oxidation state is +2 .
 
• So, KMnO4 is an oxidizing agent which reduced itself by oxidizing others.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

**Uses of KMnO4**

 
• Potassium permanganate is mostly used for its **oxidising properties**, and it is widely used because it does not generate toxic byproducts.
 
• KMnO4 is widely used as an **antiseptic to treat various fungal infections**, ulcers, wounds, and other skin conditions.
 
• It is used in water treatment to remove minerals like iron and hydrogen sulfide and to control organisms such as zebra mussels.
 
• This chemical compound is also used to **remove rust from water pipes** and equipment.
 
• Another significant use of potassium permanganate is in the **synthesis of organic compounds**.
 
• It is used in the **preservation of fruits**.
 
• It is included in survival kits as it can be used to easily start a fire.
 
• It is also used in **rocket propellant**.
 
• KMnO4 is used in treating fish diseases and parasites.
